rules.text: A change to subheading 6401.10 or tariff items 6401.92.90, 6401.99.10, 6401.99.30, 6401.99.60, 6401.99.90, 6402.91.50, 6402.91.80, 6402.91.90, 6402.99.08, 6402.99.16, 6402.99.19, 6402.99.80, 6402.99.90, 6404.11.90, or 6404.19.20 from any other heading outside headings 6401 through 6405, except from subheading 6406.10, provided that there is a regional value content of not less than 55 percent under the build-up method.
A change to all other goods of headings 6401 through 6405 from any other subheading, provided that there is a regional value content of not less than 20 percent under the build-up method.
A change to subheadings 6406.10 through 6406.90 from any other subheading.
